name: Cleanup After Trim Prime
intent: Remove wall masking and fixture covers (spray scenarios only), tear down floor protection, run final cleanup. Wall masking removal happens before floor protection teardown so masking debris falls onto the protection, not the floor.
doctrine: Removal rates are faster than installation (200 vs 150 LF/hr for wall mask, 90 vs 60 EA/hr for fixtures, 1500 vs 1200 SF/hr for floor protection) — pulling tape and bunching plastic is mechanical and quick. Final cleanup is a fixed 15 minutes for tool wash, brush soak, and area sweep, regardless of trim quantity.
